    PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',

    environment={k:env.get(k) for k in ('VIRTUAL_ENV','PATH','PYTHONPATH','MYPYPATH','PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')},

sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
print(f'GROUP={group} HEAD={head} EXIT={result.returncode}',flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)

"""Read-only closure cross-check against approved inputs and captured executions."""
import ast
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path.cwd()
MAIN = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
P = Path('docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch')
E = MAIN / P / 'a0-evidence/phase2/execution'
G = ROOT / P / 'a0-evidence/phase2/gate-package'


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def blob(revision, path):
    return git('show', f'{revision}:{path}')


inventory_raw = (G / 'deletion-inventory.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(inventory_raw).hexdigest() == '4baa85bdf82177bf3d1290cd46e8d00ccba755b7424ec16eca707ca15dfee0e3'
inventory = json.loads(inventory_raw)['entries']
groups = json.loads((G / 'commit-groups.json').read_text())
assert len(inventory) == 13 and sum(len(r['bindings']) for r in inventory) == 183
hosts = {r['path'] for r in inventory}
for item in inventory:
    path = ROOT / item['path']
    if item['scope'] == 'MODULE':
        assert not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(), item['path']
        assert not git('ls-files', '--', item['path']).strip(), item['path']
    else:
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
        imports = {
            alias.asname or alias.name
            for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))
            for alias in node.names
        }
        assert not imports & {b['name'] for b in item['bindings']}, item['path']
        assert path.is_file()
        old_tree = ast.parse(blob('f196f55', item['path']))
        new_defs = {n.name: n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
        for node in old_tree.body:
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
                assert ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(new_defs[node.name], include_attributes=False), (item['path'], node.name)
changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only', 'f196f55', 'HEAD', '--', ':(glob)tizen-*/scripts/**').decode().splitlines())
assert changed == hosts, changed ^ hosts
assert not git('diff', 'f196f55', 'HEAD', '--', 'release-v1.4.0/', 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md')
real_paths = [
    'tizen-ci-triage/scripts/ci_triage/quickbuild_log.py',
    'tizen-gerrit-fetch/scripts/tizen_gerrit_fetch/gerrit.py',
]
assert all((ROOT / p).read_bytes() == blob('f196f55', p) for p in real_paths)

# Existing functions are identical except the approved HTTP import redirects.
approved = {r['nodeid'] for r in json.loads((G / 'proposed-test-deletions.json').read_text())['entries']}
removed = set()
for path in git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'f196f55', '--', 'tests/').decode().splitlines():
    if not path.endswith('.py'):
        continue
    old_tree = ast.parse(blob('f196f55', path))
    new_tree = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) if (ROOT / path).exists() else ast.Module(body=[], type_ignores=[])
    old = {n.name: n for n in old_tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
    new = {n.name: n for n in new_tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
    for name, node in old.items():
        if name not in new:
            removed.add(f'{path}::{name}')
            continue
        for part in ast.walk(node):
            if isinstance(part, ast.ImportFrom) and part.module == 'ci_triage.quickbuild':
                part.module = 'tizen_ci_shared.quickbuild_http'
        assert ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(new[name], include_attributes=False), (path, name)
assert removed == approved, (removed, approved)

# Keep every previously recorded OBS fact and the approved gate package immutable.
protected = [
    'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md',
    'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/predicates.json',
    'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/measurement_exemptions.json',
]
old_paths = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'cb6c324', '--', str(P / 'a0-evidence')).decode().splitlines()
protected += [p for p in old_paths if p.endswith(('/raw.json', '/output.json')) or '/gate-package/' in p]
assert all((ROOT / p).read_bytes() == blob('cb6c324', p) for p in protected)

checks = ['full-tests', 'nodeids', 'mypy', 'ruff', 'lint-imports', 'entry-smoke', 'import-all', 'residual', 'packaging-final']
records = []
for group in groups:
    label = group['group'] + ('S' if group['group'] == 'C10' else 'R')
    directory = E / label
    row = {'group': group['group'], 'evidence': label}
    for check in checks:
        record = json.loads((directory / f'{check}.command.json').read_text())
        assert record['exit_code'] == 0, (label, check)
        raw = directory / f'{check}.log'
        output = raw.read_bytes() if raw.exists() else gzip.decompress(raw.with_suffix('.log.gz').read_bytes())
        assert hashlib.sha256(output).hexdigest() == record['output_sha256'], (label, check)
        row['commit'] = record['head']
    matrix = json.loads((directory / 'checkers/commands.json').read_text())
    assert not matrix['regressions'], label
    records.append(row)
last = json.loads((E / 'C13R/nodeids.log').read_text())
assert set(last['lost']) == approved and not last['changed']
assert len(last['added']) == 2
raw = E / 'C13R/residual.log'
residual = raw.read_text() if raw.exists() else gzip.decompress(raw.with_suffix('.log.gz').read_bytes()).decode()
residual_data, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(residual)
assert set(residual_data['counts']) <= {'HISTORICAL', 'HISTORICAL_KEY', 'RELEASE'}
assert len(residual_data['hosts']) == 13
guard_before = blob('6e27fec', 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/symbol_audit.py').decode()
guard_after = (ROOT / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/symbol_audit.py').read_text()
def segment(text, name):
    return ast.get_source_segment(text, next(n for n in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name))
assert segment(guard_before, '_approved_legacy_deletion') == segment(guard_after, '_approved_legacy_deletion')
assert (ROOT / 'tests/unit/test_approved_shim_deletions.py').read_bytes() == blob('6e27fec', 'tests/unit/test_approved_shim_deletions.py')
print(json.dumps({
    'hosts': len(inventory), 'bindings': sum(len(r['bindings']) for r in inventory),
    'production_changes_exactly_approved_hosts': True,
    'real_dependency_files_unchanged': real_paths,
    'removed_test_functions': sorted(removed), 'other_existing_test_bodies_unchanged': True,
    'protected_input_files_unchanged': len(protected),
    'groups': records, 'final_nodeids': last,
    'residual_counts': residual_data['counts'], 'OTHER': 0,
    'guard_and_control_semantics_unchanged': True,
}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('FINAL_PROOF=PASS')
